blocks.title: Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS)
blocks.text: IaaS bunyadi computing infrastructure, servers, storage aur networking, pay-as-you-go par deta hai. Users operating systems, applications aur storage par control rakhte hain, magar neeche ke physical infrastructure par nahi.
Amazon Web Services (AWS) users ko applications chalane ke liye virtual servers kiraye par deti hai; Microsoft Azure aur Google Compute Engine doosre IaaS providers hain.

blocks.prompt: IaaS virtual server par operating system kaun install karta hai?
blocks.explanation: User; provider sirf virtual hardware, storage aur network deta hai.

items: IaaS: servers, storage aur networks kiraye par; OS aur apps aap sambhalte hain (AWS).
